input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for general exception handler, product, shelf. Secondary concerns include search functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with shelf functionality, so that I can accomplish my shelf-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with stock clerk functionality, so that I can accomplish my stock clerk-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with stock functionality, so that I can accomplish my stock-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with warehouse functionality, so that I can accomplish my warehouse-related tasks.
